nodes.description: Mapping balanceOf recording token balances of every account; written without SafeMath in ANDR.
Nested mapping allowance[owner][spender]; set to uint(-1) for the UNI router in the constructor.
Total token supply, assigned in the constructor from the _supply argument.
Privileged owner address set to msg.sender at deployment.
Token name string.
Token symbol string.
Token decimals constant, 18.
msg.sender, the attacker-controllable caller of transfer, transferFrom, approve, delegate and batchSend.
ANDR.transfer(address _to, uint _value) payable; simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
ANDR.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) payable ensure(...); performs unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic and emits Transfer.
ANDR.approve(address _spender, uint _value) payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
ANDR.delegate(address a, bytes b) payable; owner-only delegatecall to an arbitrary caller-supplied address and calldata.
ANDR.batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) payable; owner-only loop that credits _tos with _value using unchecked arithmetic.
ANDR.pairFor(factory, tokenA, tokenB) internal pure; deterministically computes a Uniswap V2 pair address via keccak256.
ANDR.ensure(address _from, address _to) modifier; requires _from or _to to be owner or the computed UNI pair address.
ANDR constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) payable; mints supply to msg.sender and sets an infinite allowance to the router.
ERC20._transfer internal; moves balances using SafeMath and emits Transfer.
ERC20._approve internal; writes the allowance nested mapping.
ERC20._mint internal; increases _totalSupply and balance.
ERC20._burn internal; decreases balance and _totalSupply.
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn private; performs an unchecked low-level call to a token address and decodes optional return data.
SafeERC20.safeTransfer internal; encodes transfer selector and delegates to callOptionalReturn.
Address.isContract internal view; extcodehash based contract existence check.
Context._msgSender internal view; returns msg.sender.
SafeMath.add with overflow require.
SafeMath.sub with underflow require.
SafeMath.mul with overflow require.
SafeMath.div with divide-by-zero require.
a.delegatecall(b) inside ANDR.delegate: executes arbitrary code in the context of the ANDR contract while message sender is only owner-checked.
address(token).call(data) inside callOptionalReturn: unchecked low-level external call allowing callbacks into the calling contract.
balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the batchSend loop: unchecked addition (Solidity 0.5, no SafeMath).
balanceOf[_from] -= _value inside transferFrom: unchecked subtraction (Solidity 0.5, no SafeMath).
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value inside transferFrom: unchecked subtraction.
total = _value * _tos.length inside batchSend: unchecked multiplication that can overflow.
allowance[msg.sender][UNI] = uint(-1) in the constructor: grants unlimited, irrevocable spending approval to a router address.
